name: firstlightui/app-guard
description: App lifecycle events, an app-switcher privacy cover, a return shield and expiring clipboard copies.

bridge_functions.name: AppGuard.SetPrivacyCover
bridge_functions.description: Hide app content in the app switcher: a blur on iOS, FLAG_SECURE on Android.

bridge_functions.name: AppGuard.SetShieldTimeout
bridge_functions.description: Cover the app on return after this many seconds in the background, until ReleaseShield. Null disables the shield.

bridge_functions.name: AppGuard.ReleaseShield
bridge_functions.description: Fade out and remove the return shield.

bridge_functions.name: AppGuard.CopySensitive
bridge_functions.description: Copy text that stays on this device and leaves the clipboard after expiresIn seconds.
